options.command: docker buildx build --load --file tools/monorepo-image/Dockerfile --target production --tag monorepo:production .

ci-base.command: docker buildx build --load --file tools/monorepo-image/Dockerfile --target ci-base --tag monorepo:ci-base .

production.command: docker buildx build --load --file tools/monorepo-image/Dockerfile --target production --tag monorepo:production .

ci-base-push.command: docker buildx build --builder "${BUILDX_BUILDER:?BUILDX_BUILDER must be set}" --push --file tools/monorepo-image/Dockerfile --target ci-base --tag "$MONOREPO_IMAGE:ci-base" --cache-from "type=registry,ref=$BRANCH_CACHE" --cache-to "type=registry,ref=$BRANCH_CACHE,mode=max" .

production-push.command: docker buildx build --builder "${BUILDX_BUILDER:?BUILDX_BUILDER must be set}" --push --file tools/monorepo-image/Dockerfile --target production --tag "$MONOREPO_IMAGE:$DOCKER_TAG" --cache-from "type=registry,ref=$BRANCH_CACHE" --cache-to "type=registry,ref=$BRANCH_CACHE,mode=max" .
